key_notes: Key 1 (t=1.34s): Initial archival pose of house-plant; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.

why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of house-plant (1.34s..4.94s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
